== Description ==

A wide view of the tournament hall at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025, showing [[Kyle Krueger]] (standing left, maroon T-shirt), [[Brandon Baity]] (standing left-centre, olive zip jacket and khaki pants), and [[Chris Wirfs]] (seated far right, Hawaiian shirt); other players unlabeled.
